title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Lignum vitae preserves four ordered preference contrasts inside a condition for beneficial meditation
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_UNSELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. The complete cached corrected Lignum vitae prologue, including appended capitula and closing admonition, says its fruits comfort the meditating soul only with a qualification about avoiding Adam’s preference. Prologus5 then gives ordered alternatives: faith over reason, devotion over investigation, simplicity over curiosity, and the sacred cross over carnal perception/prudence. Preserve ordered preference, the same evaluating mind, and the condition on benefit; do not read a list of equally beneficial materials or infer benefits from mention alone. This is a raw content proposal, not a target gloss, religious identity or demonstrated novel mechanism.

design.possible_reading_consequence: A future openly authored complete account could use ordered composition and whole-form residuals to express repeated preference relations while preserving each preferred/disfavored argument and conditional scope. Reversing an argument pair changes the normative content; deleting the qualification turns a conditional source assertion into an unconditional benefit.

design.falsifier: Reject claimed source-content adequacy if a complete interpretation reverses one of the stated preference pairs, equates the two alternatives, or asserts unconditional benefit merely because an item is named.
